scope: Analytic integer certificate. No production execution, timing measurement, or official review. Deterministic package: the algorithm consumes zero random bits, so experiment sampling adds nothing; certificate.json is the verification artifact.

parameters.success_probability: 1 (exact; unique i*m+j decomposition over all x in [0,r))

instruction_prices.amortization_note: ceil(I/1024)=143 <= 3*M=660, charged inside the 3M batch-conversion margin; the integer inequality is a certificate check line
instruction_prices.price_anchors: pinned measurement record in tracks/docs/COST_MODEL.md: secp256k1 5x52 mul = 179 Ir, blst 384-bit base mul = 383 Ir; M=220 for a 256-bit 4x64 CIOS Montgomery multiply sits between them with margin

claim.reprice_1p2x_every_row: (6T)^20 < 5000^20 * 2^2635, i.e. the repriced bound stays >= 0.10 bits below the claim (float diagnostic margin 0.1181 bits)

coverage_lines: h*m < 2*r (at most two candidate scalars c, c+r per key match)
success.verification: profile acceptance rule [c]P=Q with 0<=c<r applied to at most 16 candidates total, charged 16*Gv

preprocessing.includes: R_setup + baby chain (m*K_rec) + baby sort (4 passes)

edge_cases_handled.Q_equals_infinity: null decode; tagged baby record j=0; scalar 0 output, matching 'The scalar 0 is valid exactly when Q=infinity'
edge_cases_handled.scalar_zero_and_one: covered by the unique i*m+j decomposition; no interval truncation exists
edge_cases_handled.rejected_encodings: duplicate keys, noncanonical hex case/length, value >= p, off-curve point, [r]Q != infinity: profile rejects; attack parses the fixed JSON shape with charged limb checks inside R_setup
edge_cases_handled.identity_and_opposite_in_chains: complete projective laws cover Z=0, Y=0, U1=U2, doubling; fallbacks charged at G inside K_rec margin and R_verify

heuristic_disclosure: None. No random walk, random mapping, random oracle, cycle-tail model, or independence assumption. All claims are exact integer arithmetic over the protected profile constants.
